heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy, with intervals of sun south.  A rising chance of rain showers in the St. Lawrence Valley this morning, increasing and spreading east midday and afternoon from northern NY and Rt. 2 north, scattered south to Rt. 4.  Highs from the mid 40s to mid 50s north to south.  Winds becoming southwest 10 to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Numerous showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, south through the Green Mountains, mixing with snow late.  Partly cloudy in southern valleys.  Lows in the 30s, near 32 north.  Winds becoming west 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly sunny in southern valleys.  Clouds from the Adirondacks and Rt. 4 north, breaking for some sun, mostly south of Rt. 2.  An isolated rain or snow showers in the mountains.  Highs from the low 40s to low 50s north to south.  Winds west to northwest near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph east of the Green Mountains, diminishing in the afternoon.
